_help: This file is public. Add one entry to 'donations' per payment received: {"date": "YYYY-MM-DD", "amount": rupees received, "via": "upi" or "kofi", "name": "only if the donor agreed to be named"}. Leave out 'name' for Anonymous. For Ko-fi, log the rupees that reached your account. The site adds up the total and supporters itself. Keep donors' phone numbers, UPI IDs and transaction references out of this file.
